dogecoin.text:
Bitcoin failed at conquering $44,000, and the subsequent rejection drove it south by $2,000. Most altcoins are also well in the red today, with Dogecoin being among the few exceptions. DOGE jumped by double-digits following news from Tesla.  # # # # #

https://t.co/DLXpJiLuZL

Elon Musk revealed that the company he spearheads – EV giant Tesla – will start accepting Dogecoin as payment for some of its merchandise.

The move that many anticipated and even more have been waiting for seems to be in the making. #cryptonews
